flagDesc.extreme_roi: ROI above 1000% in some window, usually from cash flows or definition quirks.
flagDesc.passive_pnl: All-time PnL without any own volume, likely vault or transfer driven.

tierDesc.A: Chosen by screening score and emerging signals; full fill backfill (P1).

notes.coarse_resolution: Coarse: points are more than 24h apart, intra-period drawdowns are invisible
notes.too_few_periods: Fewer than 3 valid periods; no return reported
notes.skipped_low_capital_periods: {n} periods skipped for too little capital

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: The leaderboard is a starting point, not a verdict. This is the de-noised, tiered, flow-adjusted entry to research.
overview.flagsHint: Flags never delete data; they decide which wallets are excluded from rankings by default.
overview.screeningHint: 30D TWR > 0, MDD no worse than {dd}, positive periods ≥ {pos}, reliability medium or better, noise and sub-account aggregates excluded. Built from coarse portfolio curves: worth researching, not proven skill.
overview.screeningEmpty: No enriched wallet meets the criteria yet. The worker enriches a batch of tier-B wallets every 10 minutes.
overview.newHint: Addresses that appeared on the leaderboard after the initial bulk import.
overview.newEmpty: No new wallets since the initial import. Discovery starts with the second leaderboard update.
overview.okxHint: Today's 7-day board ({date}): official {total}, {n} captured in full. Traders who drop off stay tracked; position history goes back up to 2 years.

rankings.title: Rankings
rankings.subtitle: Official values come from the Hyperliquid leaderboard; 30D TWR / MDD are computed from portfolio curves with deposits and withdrawals removed, for enriched wallets only.
rankings.rawHint: Raw mode: no flag exclusions and no activity requirement, same as the official leaderboard.
rankings.denoisedHint: Excluded: {flags}; wallets must have traded in the selected window.
rankings.empty: No wallets match. Try relaxing the filters.
rankings.sortTwrHint: Sorting by TWR/MDD includes enriched wallets only.

trader.notInDb: This address is not in the database
trader.notInDbHint: It may never have appeared on the Hyperliquid leaderboard.
trader.removed: No longer on the latest leaderboard (since {date})
trader.notEnrichedHint: This wallet is not in tier B or is still queued. Only official leaderboard values are available; no computed curve or risk metrics.
trader.officialHint: Hyperliquid does not publish its ROI definition; the leaderboard has only 1D / 7D / 30D / All windows, no 90D.
trader.computedHint: From the portfolio cumulative PnL curve: deposits, withdrawals and transfers are not returns (Modified Dietz, chain-linked TWR). Every metric shows its span, points and reliability.
trader.equityHint: Account value includes deposits and withdrawals; cumulative PnL does not. A gap between them means cash moved in or out.
trader.snapshotsHint: A full snapshot is stored every 6 hours; history starts when this system began collecting.
trader.coverageText: Fill coverage: {n} fills since {from}; last synced {synced}
trader.cyclesHint: Rebuilt from fills: each fill carries the position before it, so the path is exact. Same-coin, same-side fills less than 15 minutes apart form one decision; a cycle runs from open to flat or flip and is graded by holding time. Win rate counts complete, finished cycles net of fees; brackets show the 95% interval.
trader.cyclesNone: Fills for this wallet are not archived yet. The fill archive currently covers swing-research candidates.
trader.syncIncomplete: Fill sync not finished; figures run to {date}. The rest follows in later batches (other wallets' early fills are rescued first).
trader.coverageTextOkx: OKX position history: {n} positions since {from}; last synced {synced}
trader.cyclesHintOkx: From OKX's public position history: each record is a whole position (open time and average price, close time and average price, peak size, realized PnL). Adds and trims inside a position are not visible and the open average includes later adds, so OKX timing scores only count 1h and longer scales. Win rate uses realized PnL after fees and funding; brackets show the 95% confidence interval.
trader.syncIncompleteOkx: Position history is still being backfilled; statistics up to {date}.

health.title: Data health & system status
health.subtitle: Every collection run is recorded and every raw response archived, so we can answer “what did the system know at time T”.
health.budgetHint: Hyperliquid allows 1200 weight per minute per IP; this deployment uses {share}.
health.scheduleText: Leaderboard checked every {lb} min (conditional GET, no download when unchanged); full snapshot every {snap} h; {batch} tier-B wallets enriched every {en} min; portfolio refreshed every {days} days.
health.marketHint: Binance USDT-M 1m klines from data.binance.vision (each file SHA256-verified); Hyperliquid candles recorded by this system since it started.
health.symbolsHint: Hyperliquid fill prices compared with the Binance close of the same minute; mappings whose median ratio is more than 1% from 1 are not used.
health.okxHint: The 7-day board is crawled in full after 08:30 daily; position history runs every 5 minutes, backfills and increments by priority; budget {rpm} requests/minute. {missing} traders still need their uniqueName; {coins} coins use OKX's own candles.

hint.stable: No clear change over the last 30 days vs the 180 before
hint.declining: Two or more results clearly worse in the last 30 days (win rate, profit factor, net PnL, big loss)
hint.drifting: The way of trading changed: scalp / short share, holding time or size
hint.dormant: Traded before, nothing opened in the last 14 days
hint.hot: Last 30 days: profit factor ≥ 2, net profit and a clearly higher win rate (short-term; expect mean reversion)
hint.insufficient: Too few closed positions to compare

signals.big_loss: big single loss (vs earlier average loss)

swings.title: Macro swings
swings.subtitle: Who was on the right side of both the big BTC rally and the big drop? Cheap data finds wallets that made money on both sides; fills then verify whether the money really came from BTC/ETH direction.
swings.stage: Current stage: 1 (equity-curve screening + fill archiving). Per-coin attribution, entry/exit timing and replay come in stage 2.
swings.chartHint: Swings come from an objective zigzag (major threshold {major}, daily highs/lows), no hand-picked dates. The last leg marked * is provisional until price reverses by the threshold. Swings are a yardstick for past behaviour, not a trading signal.
swings.legsTitle: Major swings and how all wallets did
swings.legsHint: Covered = wallets whose equity curve has points within ±{days} days of both leg ends. Returns exclude deposits/withdrawals but include every asset.
swings.archiveText: {synced} of {queued} wallets synced, {fills} fills; {truncated} wallets' early fills are already outside the API window (truncated)
swings.candHint: Candidates: equity ≥ {av}, no noise flags, not a sub-account aggregate; return > {cycle} on both the latest up and down leg, or profitable on both sides across ≥ 3 legs with luck probability < {luck}.
swings.luckHint: Chance of this record if each leg were a coin flip at the peers' profitable rate for that leg. Lower = less likely luck.
swings.majorShareHint: Share of realized PnL since the cycle start that came from BTC/ETH (normalised by |PnL|, −100%..100%). Near 0 means the money was not made on BTC/ETH. Closed PnL only; approximate.
swings.empty: No data yet. The swing screen runs every 6 hours.
methodItems: Stage 1 only reads equity curves: it shows who made money on both sides, not that they did it on BTC direction. Many top-ranked wallets turned out to trade altcoins or HIP-3 stock/commodity perps.
Fill archiving is a race: the API keeps only ~10–20k recent fills per wallet, and high-frequency traders' Jul–Sep fills are already gone.

Stage 2 rebuilds BTC/ETH net exposure from fills and scores direction judgment (time aligned with the leg, lead time) separately from profit capture (capture ratio, exit quality near tops/bottoms), against buy-and-hold, moving-average trend and random-direction baselines.
The 'macro trend capture' tag needs ≥ 3 independent swings; a single great call only makes a wallet a research subject.

timing.title: Timing board
timing.subtitle: Scores where each decision was placed at its own timeframe: buying a window low or selling a window high scores high. Compared with {n} random time shifts of the same wallet's decisions to separate skill from luck.
timing.retro: Retrospective: the location score uses prices after the decision, so it grades past behaviour only; selection also needs the forward persistence test (T4).
timing.invalidWindow: This timeframe is not scored for this window: {scale} is scored in {windows}.
timing.empty: No wallets match. Only wallets with archived fills and enough decisions ({min}+) are scored.
timing.locationHint: Notional-weighted mean location; random timing is about 0.5.
timing.edgeHint: Location minus the random-shift mean, shrunk by sample size; > 0 means better placement than chance.
timing.qHint: Benjamini–Hochberg corrected significance; < 0.1 counts as significant.
timing.precisionHint: Share of decisions that hit a pivot of this timeframe (buy near a low / sell near a high).
timing.recallHint: Share of pivots during the active period that the wallet hit.
timing.alignmentHint: Share of position time aligned with the timeframe's current swing direction.
timing.panelHint: Location, excess and significance per timeframe × window (all coins). Grey cells have too few decisions or are not scored for that window.
timing.calendarHint: Each cell is that day's mean location at the timeframe (green = bought lows / sold highs, red = the opposite); the number counts pivot hits.
timing.noTiming: No timing scores yet (fills must be archived and positions rebuilt first).
timing.pending: {n} more decisions are waiting for their evaluation window to complete.
timing.twoSidedHint: Share of buys in the bottom 20% of the window / sells in the top 20%; then the same share under random time shifts. Both clearly above random means both sides are right.
timing.makerHint: Share of fills that rested on the book (not crossing). Above {p} the account looks like a market maker or grid, where buying low and selling high comes with the order type.
timing.contrarianNote: Contrarian board: lowest excess location first — traders who historically bought relatively high and sold relatively low. With "significant only", only those worse than 95% of random shifts remain. This describes the past only; being wrong before does not mean being wrong next time. Research only — do not trade against them on this basis.

zones.title: Price-zone trades
zones.subtitle: Who opened positions at key price zones and how it ended, e.g. longing BTC in the 60s, shorting at 84–88k, or getting both right.
zones.coverage: Coverage: fills archived for {archived} wallets, {covering} of them reach back to the query start; {queued} wallets are queued, so coverage grows as archiving proceeds. Only decisions that open, add to or flip into the side count.
zones.empty: No archived wallet opened this side within this price zone and period.
zones.chartTitle: Draw a zone on the {coin} daily chart
zones.chartHint: Drag a box on the chart (time × price) to query it. Shaded boxes are the current conditions; dots are matching traders' first entries (bigger = more notional).
zones.fromLegsHint: Generated from detected macro legs: start price ±3%, from 7 days before the leg start to its midpoint
zones.coverageRing: Share of the archive queue whose history reaches the query start
zones.coverageLead: Results cover {p} of the traders in the archive queue.
zones.simHint: Try following this trader in a simulation
zones.statusHint: Counted per position cycle: one open-to-flat round trip

holders.title: Swing holders
holders.subtitle: Find who really held the big moves: e.g. bought at 63k–68k and held to 83k–87k, or shorted at 82k–87k and held below 72k. Two methods that check each other.
holders.zonesHint: A position cycle whose weighted entry is inside the entry zone and that exited at least {share} of its peak size inside the exit zone; a short still held while price is already in the target zone also counts (marked to market).
holders.coverage: Coverage: fills archived for {archived} wallets, {covering} of them reach back to {start}; {queued} wallets are queued, so results grow as archiving proceeds.
holders.empty: No archived wallet has a qualifying cycle. Holders of whole moves are rare; more may appear as low-turnover wallets finish archiving.
holders.captureHint: Across one macro leg, the actual position is marked to market hourly: share of time with / against the leg, and capture = mark-to-market PnL / (peak notional × leg move). 1.0 = a full position held for the whole leg; rolling and scaling in/out all count. Fees and funding excluded.
holders.noLegs: No leg capture data yet (fills must be archived and timing scores computed).
holders.captureEmpty: No wallet passes the filters. Try a lower time-with-leg or size threshold.
holders.minShareExplain: At least {p} of the position closed in the target zone (or still held there)

sum.holdingSub: price is inside the exit zone

replay.title: K-line replay
replay.hint: Every buy / sell (B / S) on this coin over the candles; dotted circles are the timeframe's local highs and lows (H / L). The closer B sits to L and S to H, the better the timing.
replay.none: No decisions to replay for this wallet yet (fills must be archived first).
replay.noCandles: No candles for this coin at this interval (neither Binance nor Hyperliquid covers it).

watch.title: Watchlist
watch.subtitle: Wallets you follow, by group. Watched wallets get their fills archived first, so scores, replay and alerts have complete data.
watch.confirmDelete: Delete group “{name}”? Its entries are removed (wallet data is kept).
watch.empty: No wallets in this group yet. Click ☆ next to any wallet to add it.
watch.renameHint: Used on every page and in alert emails; no need to watch first. Save it empty to go back to the original name.

alerts.title: Position alerts
alerts.subtitle: Subscribed wallets are checked every few seconds; changes that match your conditions are emailed. Bursts from one wallet are merged into one email.
alerts.coins: Only these coins (comma separated, empty = all)
alerts.smtpMissing: No sender mailbox configured yet: events are recorded but not emailed.
alerts.empty: No subscriptions yet. Click 🔔 next to any wallet.
alerts.baseline: The first check only records positions as a baseline and sends nothing.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Sender mailbox and live monitor. The password is stored encrypted on the server and never shown.
settings.smtpHint: Gmail: turn on 2-Step Verification, then create an App Password (16 characters) and paste it below (not your login password). Host smtp.gmail.com, port 587, STARTTLS. Other providers: use their SMTP details.
settings.publicUrl: Site URL for email links (e.g. http://194.163.135.37:3200)
settings.intervalHint: Default 30 s uses about 20% of the Hyperliquid limit (separate budget). With many subscriptions a round can take longer than the interval.
settings.notRunning: The live process is not running yet (it starts automatically after deployment).

sims.title: Copy simulation
sims.subtitle: Paper-follow traders at live mid prices: every 30 s their positions are read and the simulated book is adjusted to your capital and rules, with fees, slippage, funding and liquidation. Simulations are independent.

stats.cappedSub: {n} of {total} rebalances exceeded the cap at their proportions

sims.listHint: Copy return = change in simulated equity. Leader return uses their account value, which includes deposits and withdrawals, so treat it as a reference. Retention = copy return ÷ leader return: how much delay, slippage and sizing limits gave up.

cols.retentionHint: Copy return ÷ leader return; blank when the leader moved under 0.5%

sims.empty: No simulations yet. Use “Copy sim” on a trader page, or enter an address above.
sims.calendarHint: All simulations combined; daily PnL = last equity of the day − last equity of the previous day. Darker = larger.
sims.noDaily: No daily data yet; it appears after the first full day.
sims.corrHint: Correlation of daily returns, computed with at least {n} common days. High correlation means the leaders bet the same way and diversify little.
sims.periodHint: Return, drawdown and closed-cycle statistics per period. A cycle runs from flat to flat on one coin (a flip closes one and opens another); PnL is net of fees and funding.
sims.chartHint: Top: simulated return and the leader's account value change (dashed, includes transfers). Bottom: daily PnL ({tz}).

chart.empty: Waiting for the first equity snapshot (the live process runs every 30 s).

sims.posHint: Simulated positions with the leader's latest size. Positions the leader held before the start are not chased (the entry would differ); they are followed after the leader closes or flips them.
sims.preexistingHint: The leader held this before the simulation started; it is followed after a close or flip. Tick “copy existing positions” when creating to follow at once.
sims.cycleHint: Latest 100; open cycles show as open.
sims.tradesHint: Latest 200. Fill price = mid ± slippage; cost = fee + slippage (funding listed separately).
sims.editHint: Changes apply to later rebalancing only; history is not recomputed.

controls.confirmStop: Stopping closes every simulated position at the next cycle's live prices and cannot be undone. Stop?
controls.confirmDelete: Deleting removes all fills and equity history of this simulation. Delete?

form.leaderHint: A Hyperliquid address, or an OKX trader (okx:authorId; “Copy sim” on a trader page fills it in)
form.name: Name

sizingHints.equity_ratio: Use the same share of your balance as the leader uses of theirs (times the copy ratio). Closest to real copy trading.
sizingHints.fixed_multiple: Size = their size × factor, regardless of your capital.
sizingHints.fixed_cap: A fixed USD amount per coin; direction only.

form.maxLeverageHint: Scales down when gross exposure exceeds equity × this
form.leverageCapHint: Each position uses the leader’s leverage on that coin, but no more than this (the coin’s own limit also applies). Unknown leader leverage counts as 20x.
form.followLeverageHint: Only the coin’s own limit applies (on Hyperliquid it varies per coin, e.g. 40x for BTC; up to 125x on OKX). Margin and liquidation prices match the leader’s, so the simulated PnL lines up; untick to set your own cap.
form.drawdownHint: Close everything and stop past this drawdown from peak
form.rebalanceHint: Skip when target and current differ by less
form.followAdjust: Follow adds and trims (off: only opens, closes and flips)
form.copyExisting: Copy the leader's existing positions (open now at current prices)
form.saved: Saved; applies from the next cycle.
form.ratioHint: Your size = ratio × (their position ÷ their equity) × your equity. 100% = the same share; 200% = double; 50% = half.

leverageModeHints.account: All positions share your capital; gross exposure stays within max leverage; the whole account is liquidated when margin runs out.
leverageModeHints.leader: Each position uses the leader’s leverage on that coin with its own margin and liquidation price (optionally capped; the coin’s limit always applies); a liquidated position loses only its margin.

form.formula: Your size = copy ratio × (leader's position ÷ leader's balance) × your balance
form.followExposureHint: No scaling down by max leverage: your positions are the same multiple of equity as theirs, so returns match. The account is still liquidated when margin runs out.

okx.curveHint: OKX-reported realized PnL (after fees, funding and liquidation penalties) summed by each position's close day; open positions are not included.
okx.presenceHint: Days on OKX's lead-trader leaderboards (by return); the 7-day board counts complete daily crawls.
okx.neverRanked: No leaderboard record (imported from favourites or old data)
okx.granularity: OKX publishes whole positions, not fills: the timing of adds and trims is not visible. Traders who dropped off the boards are still checked weekly for new positions.
okx.ranksHint: Rank and official figures from each complete daily crawl; win rate and max drawdown are OKX's own definitions.

okxBoard.title: OKX lead-trader boards
okxBoard.subtitle: OKX's official 7-day board is crawled in full every day at 08:30 (Beijing), plus the top 100 of the 30/90/365-day boards. Beyond the official numbers we compute realized PnL, liquidations and timing scores from each trader's public position history; a high rank is not a reason to copy.

titles.dropped: Off the board, with full history

okxBoard.runHint: Crawled {date}: official total {total}, {n} captured, {new} new; finished {at}. {partial}
okxBoard.partial: Only the top pages of this board are crawled.
okxBoard.droppedHint: Traders not on the current board whose position history is fully backfilled, by realized PnL over 90 days. Dropping off can be a short drawdown, or a good trader no longer chasing rank.

market.title: Market positioning radar
market.subtitle: Real positions of the Hyperliquid wallets and OKX lead traders we keep polling: who is long, who is short, what they opened lately and where their liquidation prices cluster. This is our observed sample, not the whole exchange.

cohortHints.all: Every polled trader with fresh data
cohortHints.timing: Traders whose timing score stays significant after multiple-testing correction (q < 0.1) at any scale
cohortHints.okx_board: OKX lead traders on today's 7-day board

market.coverage: {fresh} traders with fresh data of {watched} polled (Hyperliquid {hl}, OKX {okx}) · last poll {latest} min ago. Positions older than two poll intervals are not counted.
market.mapHint: Area = notional, colour = share of traders long (green long-heavy, red short-heavy). Click a coin for details.
market.coinsHint: One net position per trader and coin; opens = new positions and flips in the last 1 / 4 / 24 hours (positions first seen open are not opens).

cols.nearLiqHint: Distance to the nearest long liquidation (below) and short liquidation (above), venue-reported prices only

market.historyHint: Recorded hourly at :55, from the day collection started; the past is never reconstructed from current positions.
market.historyEmpty: Snapshots are still accumulating (at least two hours needed).
market.liqHint: Venue-reported liquidation prices only; cross-margin prices move with margin and price and are not exact triggers. {without} positions ({withoutNtl}) have no liquidation price and {outside} lie outside the range; neither is counted.
market.liqEmpty: No positions with a liquidation price in this range.
market.contribHint: Every position behind the numbers above, by notional. Open time: from the venue on OKX; on Hyperliquid only known to lie between two polls, and unknown for positions already open when first seen.
market.eventsHint: Position changes between polls. Exact: open time reported by the venue; window: between the previous and this poll. Entry prices are shown only when the venue reports them, never replaced by the market price.
market.noEvents: No matching changes in this period.
market.entryHint: Venue-reported average entries by notional; shaded = concentration zones (the peak and neighbours ≥ 25% of it, holding ≥ 5% of the side). Reference price {px} (polled {t}).
market.liqHint2: Venue-reported liquidation prices only ({known} of notional has one); longs below the price, shorts above. {without} positions without one and {crossed} whose price is already crossed (stale) are left out. Cross margin is {cross}: those prices move with margin and price and are not exact triggers.
market.ladderHint: Cumulative long / short notional whose liquidation price a fall (left) or rise (right) of that size would reach. Observed sample, not the whole market.
market.zonesHint: Entry zones are where the cost sits; liquidation zones are where high-leverage positions are fragile. “Show” filters the positions below to the zone.
market.whaleHint: 1–2 positions only: one large trader's level, not a crowd's cost or liquidation zone

discover.title: Style discovery
discover.subtitle: Find traders by style: every label carries its rules, the trader's values, sample sizes and an out-of-sample check (judged on data from {days} days ago, then the later positions of that kind must stay profitable). Labels are research leads, not copy advice.

styleHints.steady: Profitable across many months, good profit factor, profits not from one or two trades, contained realized drawdown, rarely liquidated — and no large open loss right now (this catches traders who close winners and sit on losers).
styleHints.trend: Swing and macro positions profitable overall, with significant macro / swing timing or a high leg capture. Timing scores are not point-in-time, so this stops at candidate.
styleHints.swing: Positions held 3 days to 3 weeks: profit factor ≥ 1.3, win-rate lower bound ≥ 40%, profitable overall.
styleHints.bottom: Buys tend to sit low in their window (location ≥ 0.7, buying at extremes 1.5× the random baseline), longs profitable overall.
styleHints.top_short: Shorts profitable overall (profit factor ≥ 1.3, win-rate lower bound ≥ 40%), selling high in the window — not just a permanent short that met a fall.
styleHints.scalper: Over 60% of positions held under 4 hours, still profitable after fees. Such an edge often comes from execution speed a follower cannot copy.
styleHints.low_dd: Realized drawdown under 10% of the account, no liquidation, open loss under 5%, profitable overall.
styleHints.specialist: Over 60% of traded notional in one coin, and profitable there (profit factor ≥ 1.3, win-rate lower bound ≥ 45%).
styleHints.high_risk: A risk flag, not an ability: liquidation rate ≥ 5%, median leverage ≥ 30×, or one trade making 60%+ of all profit — any one triggers it.

statusHints.verified: The rules held out of sample
statusHints.candidate: Every rule holds on the full history
statusHints.watch: One rule short, or one input unknown

oos.passed: Passed out of sample: qualified on data before {cut}; the {n} later cycles of this kind made {net}, profit factor {pf}.
oos.failed: Failed out of sample: the {n} cycles after {cut} made {net}, profit factor {pf}.
oos.notTested: Not tested out of sample: the data before the cut {status}.
oos.notPit: Relies on timing scores, which cannot be recomputed as of the past, so no out-of-sample check.

discover.oosNote: Verified = qualified on data from {days} days ago, and later positions of that kind stayed profitable (at least 5, profit factor ≥ 1).
discover.noOosNote: This style relies on timing scores (not point-in-time), so it stops at candidate.
discover.riskNote: A risk flag: flagged traders may still make money, but the results are hard to copy and survival risk is high.
discover.copyHard: Such an edge is usually hard to copy.
discover.profileHint: Open any style label to see the rules, values and samples behind it; the factors below come from all closed cycles (whole positions on OKX, cycles rebuilt from fills on Hyperliquid).
discover.noStyles: No style rule is met (or the sample is too small).

top.hint: Short-term results, not proof of skill. OKX: realized PnL of positions closed in the period over lead-trading assets; at least 5 closes, no liquidation in the period, assets ≥ $1k, excluding traders with an open loss over 30% of assets. Hyperliquid: the official leaderboard's week / month ROI, accounts ≥ $10k without noise flags, with the flow-adjusted 30-day drawdown.

toast.watched: Followed — their fills will be archived first
toast.simCreated: Simulation created; it follows every 30 seconds
toast.renamed: Renamed: pages and alert emails now use the new name

legs.title: Swing hall of fame
legs.subtitle: Macro up and down legs are detected per coin. For each leg: who captured most of it, who entered at the turn, and who sat on the wrong side. Buttons open the zone and holder tools for that leg.
legs.empty: No macro legs detected for this coin yet (needs enough candles and archived positions).
legs.provisionalHint: The last leg has not reversed enough yet; its end may still move
legs.note: Definitions: captured = positioned with the leg ≥ 50% of the time and max notional ≥ {mn}, ranked by capture ratio; at the turn = opened the leg's side near its start (time −10%…+15%, price ±{pad}); wrong side = against the leg more than half the time, ranked by loss. Archived traders only, in hindsight.

card.timingHint: Best timing score that stays significant after multiple testing (q < 0.1)
card.scope: Scope: closed, complete position cycles, net of fees; all closed positions total {net}. Click a card to replay it on the chart.

follow.title: If you had followed
follow.hint: Applies this account's time-weighted return (deposits and withdrawals removed) to your capital from a start date. Hindsight: your own copy delay, slippage and fees are not included, and it says nothing about the future.
follow.insufficient: Not enough account data in this period.
follow.notes: Based on {n} equity points about {step} days apart; intra-period swings are not visible.
follow.notCovered: Account data starts after the chosen date; computed from the earliest point.

timeline.title: Position timeline
timeline.hint: Each bar is one open-to-flat round trip: length = holding time, green long, red short, stronger = bigger result; dashed = still open. Click to replay.
timeline.legend: Last {n} position cycles (6 most traded coins)

similar.title: Traders with a similar style
similar.hint: Closest by how they trade (leverage, long/short mix, holding time, win rate, drawdown, coin concentration…), not by how much they made. Only traders with {n}+ closed positions.

luck.title: Luck or skill
luck.lead: Actual location {loc}, better than {better} of random-time versions (p = {p}).
luck.notSignificant: Luck cannot be ruled out yet.
luck.pending: The random distribution appears after the next timing run (every 3 hours).
luck.explain: Grey bars: the scores of the same trades shifted to random times 500 times — what the same activity achieves by luck. The further right of the grey the blue line sits, the less likely the timing is chance.

compare.title: Compare traders
compare.subtitle: Two to four traders on the same metrics. Following two highly correlated traders is close to following one.
compare.tip: "Compare" on a trader page or "Compare" under similar traders fills this in.
compare.curveHint: Net PnL of closed positions summed by close day (same rule for both venues); open positions excluded.
compare.noCurve: No closed positions in this period.
compare.corrHint: 1 = move together, 0 = unrelated, negative = offset each other. Not computed with fewer than 10 shared days.

divergence.title: Smart money vs the crowd
divergence.hint: Per coin: share of long traders among timing-significant traders (blue needle) vs all observed traders (grey). The bigger the gap, the more the groups disagree. Coins held by fewer than {n} significant traders are hidden. Click a card for its history.
divergence.empty: No coin is held by at least {n} timing-significant traders right now.
divergence.historyTitle: {coin}: divergence history and the next 7 days
divergence.caveat: Divergence is drawn next to the later move to show the historical relation only, not as a forecast; the sample is the traders we observe, not the whole market.

sentinel.saved: Sentinel saved: you will get an email when new traders open in this zone
sentinel.explain: Checked every 30 minutes: from now on, any new trader opening this side inside this price zone triggers an email (follows fill archiving, so it lags the trade a little).
sentinel.name: Name
sentinel.confirmDelete: Delete this sentinel and its hits?
sentinel.title: Price-zone sentinels
sentinel.hint: Saved zone queries that email you when new traders open inside the zone. Create one from the top right of a price-zone result.

digest.enable: Email the daily digest at 00:20 UTC
digest.title: Daily digest
digest.settingsHint: Every day: what your watched traders did, coins where significant traders and the crowd disagree most, newly significant traders and sentinel hits. The overview shows the latest one.
digest.cardHint: Last 24 hours, from the traders we observe.
digest.noMoves: No changes observed for watched traders.
digest.baseline: First digest: {n} traders are significant now; new ones are marked from tomorrow.

find.title: 1. Find traders who make money
find.text: Browse by style — steady compounding, trends, bottoms, tops — each label with its rules and evidence.

verify.title: 2. Check it's skill, not luck
verify.text: Are their entries and exits far better than random? The timing board tests it against 500 random shifts.

try.title: 3. Try it in a simulation
try.text: Copy at live prices with fees, slippage and funding — see the result before risking money.

entries.label: Entries
entries.text: Decisions that open, add to or flip into the side within the zone and period. Consecutive fills count once.

realized.label: Realized
realized.text: Profit or loss of the parts already closed, after fees.

unrealized.label: Unrealized
unrealized.text: Estimated PnL of what is still open at the latest price; it moves with the price.

macroEdge.label: Macro excess
macroEdge.text: Macro-scale timing score minus the random level. Above 0 = better than random at the macro scale.

exitedShare.label: Exited in zone
exitedShare.text: Share of the peak position closed inside the target exit zone.
exitedShare.example: E.g. peak 10 BTC, 8 BTC closed at 83–87k = 80%.

holdingShare.label: Still held
holdingShare.text: For an open position, the share of the peak position still held.

moveCaptured.label: Move captured
moveCaptured.text: Price move from entry to exit (or current price), signed by side.

capture.label: Capture ratio
capture.text: Marked PnL during the leg ÷ (max position × leg move). 1 = the whole leg at full size, 0.3 = 30% of it.

timeAligned.label: Time aligned
timeAligned.text: Share of the leg's time spent positioned in the leg's direction.

location.label: Location
location.text: Where a trade sits in the surrounding price range: buying the low or selling the high scores 1, random trades about 0.5.

edge.label: Excess
edge.text: Location minus the average of the same trades at random times, shrunk by sample size. Above 0 = better than luck.

q.label: q-value
q.text: Significance adjusted for testing many traders at once. q < 0.1 = still significant among so many.

twr.label: TWR
twr.text: Time-weighted return: the real return with deposits and withdrawals removed.

mdd.label: Max drawdown
mdd.text: Largest fall from a peak to a later low — the worst loss a follower would have sat through.

ddRatio.label: Drawdown/profit
ddRatio.text: Max drawdown of the realized PnL curve ÷ total profit. Lower is steadier: 0.2 = gave back at most 20 per 100 made.

profitFactor.label: Profit factor
profitFactor.text: Total profit of winners ÷ total loss of losers. Above 1 makes money; 1.5+ is good.

divergence.label: Divergence
divergence.text: Long share among timing-significant traders minus long share among everyone observed. Positive = smart money more bullish than the crowd.

retention.label: Retention
retention.text: Copy return ÷ the leader's own return. 100% = the follower got all of it; less is what delay, slippage, fees and sizing differences ate.

delay.label: Delay sensitivity
delay.text: Copy return with no delay, 30 s, 5 min, 30 min and 2 h. The faster it falls, the harder the trader is to copy (typical of scalpers).

copyability.label: Copyability
copyability.text: 0-100: not how much they make, but whether you can make it by copying them. A ≥ 80, B ≥ 65, C ≥ 50.

mae.label: Worst floating loss
mae.text: The largest unrealized loss a position showed between open and close: the most painful moment of holding it.
mae.example: E.g. long, down to -300, then closed at +200: worst floating loss -300.

margin.label: Margin
margin.text: Notional ÷ leverage: the capital the position ties up. Cross-margin positions share the account's equity, so this is an estimate from the leverage.

copyBoard.title: Copy profit board
copyBoard.subtitle: If you had copied these traders over the last 7 / 30 / 90 days with one setting, after fees, slippage and a 30-second delay, who would have made you the most? Replayed nightly from real trades and candles.
copyBoard.notYet: Not computed yet (nightly at 01:00 UTC, and 20 minutes after the service starts)
copyBoard.hint: Same setting for all: $10k, 100% proportional copy, 30 s delay, 4.5 bp fee, 3 bp slippage, max 10x, cross margin. Pool: watchlist, simulated, style-labelled, timing-significant and OKX-board traders.
copyBoard.approxHint: OKX has no equity history; current lead assets are used, so the ratio may be off
copyBoard.method: Method: every open, add, reduce and close at its real time plus the delay, filled at the finest candle available (1 minute to 1 hour), liquidation checked hourly. OKX only records whole positions, so a follower enters at the first open and exits at the final close and misses intermediate adds and trims. Funding not modelled. Hindsight, not a forecast.

copyCard.title: Copyability score
copyCard.hint: Skill significance, a real copy backtest, drawdown, liquidations and leverage, latency sensitivity, sample and concentration; out of 100, each part with its evidence.
copyCard.pending: Not scored yet (nightly for the candidate pool).
copyCard.insufficient: Insufficient: fewer than 15 closed positions or no usable copy backtest.

ev.latencyNa: the instant copy itself does not make money; latency cannot be measured

backtest.title: Historical copy backtest
backtest.hint: No need to wait weeks: replay their real trade times on candles and see what copying with your setting would have done, with delay, fees, slippage and liquidation.
backtest.idle: Set the parameters and run the backtest.

reasons.no_leader_equity: No leader equity (OKX needs lead assets); a proportional backtest is not possible.
reasons.too_many_decisions: Too many trades (over 20,000 decisions); shorten the period.

backtest.delayTitle: Delay sensitivity: copy return at different delays

equity.history: Leader equity from the account history.
equity.current_assets: OKX has no equity history; current lead assets set the ratio (approximate).

backtest.capped: {p} of the time their ratio exceeded max leverage and was capped: the result reflects the cap more than their sizing.
backtest.notes: Liquidation checked hourly at the high / low; funding not modelled; OKX records whole positions only. Hindsight, not a forecast.

behavior.title: Behaviour fingerprint
behavior.hint: When they trade and how they treat wins and losses, from archived trades; no conclusion on small samples.

flagHint.holds_losers: Losing positions are held over twice as long as winners
flagHint.lets_winners_run: Winners are held 1.5× longer than losers
flagHint.fat_tail_losses: Largest loss over 8× the average loss: one trade can hurt a follower badly
flagHint.cuts_losses: Largest loss under 3× the average loss
flagHint.sizes_up_after_loss: After 30%+ of losing closes, the next position within 24h is over 1.5× the median size
flagHint.averages_down: 60%+ of adds are at a worse price than the average entry
flagHint.size_up: Median position size in the last 30 days is 2×+ earlier
flagHint.leverage_up: Median leverage in the last 30 days is 1.5×+ earlier

boards.error: Failed to load; try again later.

risk.title: Liquidation early warning
risk.hint: Sorted by distance to the venue-reported liquidation price, all coins. Cross-margin liquidation prices move with margin and other positions. Observed sample, not the whole market.

liq.title: Suspected liquidations
liq.hint: The position disappeared with the price at (within 0.5%) or beyond the liquidation price it last reported: inferred, not the exchange's record. Recorded from this update on.
liq.empty: No suspected liquidations in this window (only closes after this update are checked).

opens.title: Large opens · {n} · {ntl} total
opens.hint: Opens, adds and flips seen between two polls, newest first; filter by size, side and cohort (e.g. timing-significant traders).

under.title: Underwater
under.hint: The largest open losses, and whether the trader kept adding while underwater in the last 72 hours — the positions most likely to blow up next.

whales.title: Whale moves
whales.hint: The largest positions and their recent adds (▲) and trims (▼).
